subject: general
question: Which international organisation launched the 'AI for Good' initiative in 2025?

options.text: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization
Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Telecommunication Union**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **AI for Good** initiative was launched by the **International Telecommunication Union (ITU)** in 2017, not 2025, to promote the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for advancing sustainable development goals (SDGs).
 
• It is a leading platform where governments, industries, and academia collaborate to discuss the use of AI for solving global challenges such as poverty, healthcare, and climate change.
 
• The initiative includes **AI for Good Global Summits**, which bring together stakeholders to exchange ideas and showcase AI innovations.
 
• ITU is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for issues related to information and communication technologies (ICT).
 
• The "AI for Good" initiative aims to ensure that AI technologies are used ethically, inclusively, and responsibly to serve humanity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Telecommunication Union (ITU):**

 
 
• Founded in 1865, ITU is the oldest international organization in the UN system and focuses on global telecommunications and ICT development.
 
• Its headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• ITU works on global standards for communication technologies, spectrum allocation, and bridging the digital divide.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI):**
 
 
• AI refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines programmed to think and learn.
 
• Applications of AI include natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and predictive analytics.
 
• Ethical concerns such as bias, privacy, and accountability are central to discussions about AI deployment.
 
 
 
• **AI for Good Global Summits:**
 
 
• These summits are annual events organized by ITU in partnership with other UN agencies.
 
• The summits aim to connect innovators in AI with public and private sectors to leverage AI for solving real-world issues.
 
• Focus areas include healthcare, education, agriculture, and climate action.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The SDGs are a set of 17 global objectives adopted by the UN in 2015 to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure prosperity for all by 2030.
 
• AI has the potential to accelerate progress on SDGs by offering innovative solutions to complex challenges.
